question: Should OpenClaw approve the ACPX 0.12.0 dependency graph on this exact rebased external-contributor head, or require a maintainer-owned dependency regeneration?
rationale: The change updates a bundled executable and a security-owned shrinkwrap; repository automation deliberately leaves acceptance of the exact resolved artifacts to a trusted human reviewer.

options.title: Approve Exact Head
options.body: Review the ACPX, ACP SDK, and `tsx` artifact delta and authorize the rebased SHA after exact-head OpenClaw proof is attached.

options.title: Regenerate Internally
options.body: Land the manifest and lock changes from a maintainer-owned branch, then rebase the contributor's docs and wrapper compatibility work onto that approved graph.

options.title: Defer Adoption
options.body: Pause the PR if the project is not ready to bundle ACPX 0.12.0 and ACP SDK 1.1.0.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact Head
recommendation.body: Review the ACPX, ACP SDK, and `tsx` artifact delta and authorize the rebased SHA after exact-head OpenClaw proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history across the ACPX runtime and docs surface and co-authored the current lease/wrapper implementation; secops review is additionally required for the shrinkwrap.
